name: Great Western
accommodation: En-suite hotel bedrooms, including family and dog-friendly rooms
beachAccess: Clifftop on Cliff Road, just steps from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Bar, dining, pub garden, ocean-view terrace, WiFi
overview: A St Austell Brewery inn on Cliff Road, set on the clifftop above Great Western Beach and just steps from the sand. It has en-suite rooms, including family and dog-friendly options. Downstairs there is an open-plan bar and dining area with a terrace looking out to sea.
surfTripFit: You can walk straight down to Great Western, and Towan and Tolcarne are both close by.
